# Ward's World

> > Free, comprehensive science education resources spanning biology, chemistry, physics, geology, and STEM for K-12 classrooms and learners of all ages.

Ward's World is a free science education platform from Ward's Science offering videos, activities, lesson plans, and hands-on resources across multiple science disciplines. The site serves teachers, students, and educators with classroom-ready materials, safety guidelines, and interactive learning content designed to make science education accessible and engaging.

## Key Topics

- STEM education
- Hands-on learning
- Classroom activities
- Science experiments
- Lab safety
- Biology education
- Chemistry
- Physics
- Environmental science
- Teacher resources
- Interactive learning
- Student engagement
- OpenSciEd
- Science Olympiad
- CTE

## Subject Areas

- [Biology made easy! Free science education help](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/biology): Biology subject hub with free videos, articles & classroom activities
- [Free Chemistry Lesson Plans: Science Education made easy!](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/chemistry): Chemistry subject hub with lesson plans, labs & teacher resources
- [Free Physics Resources](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/physics): Physics subject hub with free videos, activities & demonstrations
- [Geology & Earth Science videos, activities and articles to make teaching easy!](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/geology-earth-science): Geology & Earth Science subject hub with videos & lesson resources

## Grade-Level & Learning Paths

- [K-5](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/k-5): Elementary science education resources for K-5 grade levels
- [STEM & Makerspace Learning Resources](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/stem-makerspace): STEM & makerspace hub with classroom resources & hands-on projects
- [Science by You](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/science-by-you): Student-submitted science activities & interactive learning content

## Hands-On Labs & Activities

- [Borax Snowflake Lab](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/ws-science-by-you-borax-snowflake-lab-2): 9th grade chemistry lab: build snowflakes with borax crystals
- [The Magic of Crystals: A crystal formation video & kit for middle and high-school science teachers](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/the-magic-of-crystals-the-wonderful-world-of-crystal-formation): Crystal formation video & kit for middle & high school chemistry
- [Strength of Magnetic and Electric Forces Lab - Electromagnetic Induction](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/ws-science-by-you-activity-electromagnetic-induction-2): Electromagnetic induction lab demonstrating magnetic & electric forces
- [Is road salt bad for the environment? A free science activity to investigate a slippery dilemma.](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/how-does-road-salt-affect-our-environment-a-free-activity-to-investigate-a-slippery-dilemma): Environmental science activity: road salt impact on ecosystems
- [Healthcare Escape Room Activity – Hands-On Medical Skills for the Classroom](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/healthcare-escape-room-activity-2): Healthcare escape room with 9 stations: CPR, vital signs & diagnostics

## Teacher Resources & Guides

- [Classroom and Lab Safety Resources](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/safety): Lab safety tips, guidelines & resources for science classrooms
- [How to choose the right human anatomy model for your biology or Healthcare Ed classroom.](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/buying-guide-how-to-choose-the-right-anatomy-model): Buying guide comparing anatomy models by tier, detail & cost
- [Owl Pellet Poster Classroom Download](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/owl-pellet-poster-3): Free owl pellet dissection poster with bone diagrams & labels

## Featured Stories & Partnerships

- [STEM at 29,000 Feet](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/from-peaks-to-ph-water-science-at-the-top-of-the-world): Megan Rath's Mount Everest water quality testing STEM adventure
- [Teaching with OpenSciEd Just Got Easier](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/making-openscied-easier-and-more-impactful): Ward's Science OpenSciEd kits simplify curriculum implementation
- [The CTE Appreciation Calendar for Teachers](https://wardsworld.wardsci.com/home/a-year-of-cte-classroom-connections): Career observances & hands-on CTE classroom connections calendar
